question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"work."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Work" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"Work"** means the job that you do, especially in order to earn money; the place where you do your job. (काम, नौकरी (विशेषतः धनार्जन के लिए); नौकरी करने की जगह, कार्य-स्‍थल (दफ़्तर या फ़ैक्‍टरी आदि))
 
 
• **Example**: *It is very difficult to find **work**__ in this city.*
 
 
 
• It fits the context of the question, which is asking for a location or activity.
 
• **"Bank"** and** "office" **could also be appropriate, but they are more specific than the context of the question.
 
• **"Home"** is not as appropriate because it is not necessarily a location of work.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

An 'occupational disease' is any disease __caused__ primarily by exposure at work __to__ a physical, organisational, chemical or biological risk __factor__ or to a combination of these factors. Occupational diseases are __mostly__ those listed in national legislation as resulting from exposure to risk factors at __**work**__.
